# HWOrderIndependentTransparency <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [World](Blitz3D-World)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HWOrderIndependentTransparency:Int32
```

**Returns:** 1 if order-independent transparency can be turned on, else 0.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Says whether [GraphicsOrderIndependentTransparency](GraphicsOrderIndependentTransparency) can be used on the graphics driver in use. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such function. It needs a pass with four color attachments of half floats that can be blended, which every driver that BlitzLLVM draws 3D with has.
